cards.headline: Infrastructure Standard Introduced to Reduce Multi-Cloud Tool Lock-In
cards.what_happened: A major open specification was released for AI developer workflows. The Linux Foundation and CNCF announced the creation of the Open Agent Protocol (OAP), a v.
cards.why_it_matters: Engineering teams gain cross-provider interoperability for distributed agent runtimes. Closed single-model ecosystems lose leverage over client tool pipelines.
second_order: Tool providers standardize on unified RPC schemas rather than vendor-specific SDK wrappers
Internal service proxies enforce access control policies at the organization network perimeter
Switching costs between frontier model providers drop significantly

predictions.statement: Within 30 days of release, provider pricing page confirms prompt caching with >75% discount.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Official provider pricing page documents >75% reduction on cached input prompt tokens.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. Multiple frontier providers introduced prompt caching with up to 90% discount on cache hits.

predictions.statement: Within 90 days, an open-source Apache-2.0 weight model ranks in the top 5 on LMSYS Coding Leaderboard.
predictions.resolution_criteria: LMSYS Coding Arena leaderboard public standings show an Apache-2.0 model in ranks 1 through 5.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. DeepSeek-Coder-V2 achieved position #4 on the LMSYS coding leaderboard.

predictions.statement: Within 90 days, EU AI Act guidelines mandate synthetic watermarking in all commercial code completion tools.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Final EU AI Office regulatory text explicitly mandates synthetic watermarking in code tools.
predictions.postmortem: Wrong. The AI Office retained watermarking for video/audio, but exempted standalone code completion tools.

predictions.statement: Within 90 days of TPU v5e general availability, cloud spot market discount exceeds 65% against on-demand.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Google Cloud public pricing table records preemptible/spot TPU v5e pricing >65% below on-demand.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. Spot discounts on TPU v5e reached 70% in central regions.

predictions.statement: Within 30 days, major provider deprecates legacy v1 completions API in favor of chat/messages endpoint.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Completions API endpoint decommissioned with 410 Gone status.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. Legacy completions endpoint retired on schedule.

predictions.statement: Within 90 days, PyTorch 2.5 includes native support for dynamic shape FP8 tensor cores.
predictions.resolution_criteria: PyTorch release notes officially confirm dynamic FP8 execution in standard inductor.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. PyTorch 2.5 included native FP8 dynamic shape support.

predictions.statement: Within 30 days of launch, hosted Postgres provider announces per-gigabyte disk billing for HNSW vector indexes.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Official billing docs show separate metered storage line-item for vector indexes.
predictions.postmortem: Wrong. Provider bundled vector disk storage into standard compute tiers rather than unbundling index metering.

predictions.statement: Within 90 days, a top-3 cloud provider enforces mandatory multi-factor hardware keys for root accounts.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Official security bulletin mandating hardware FIDO2 keys for root account logins.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. AWS and Google Cloud both mandated FIDO2 MFA for organization root accounts.

predictions.statement: Within 90 days, leading frontier chat UI introduces 1-click artifact code deployment to live URLs.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Chat interface includes native button to publish interactive React artifacts to unique public subdomains.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. Anthropic Artifacts sharing allowed direct one-click public URL previews.

predictions.statement: Within 30 days of CUDA 12.8 release candidate, release notes officially deprecate Pascal GPU architecture.
predictions.resolution_criteria: NVIDIA CUDA toolkit release documentation explicitly marks sm_60 and sm_61 as deprecated.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. CUDA 12.8 formally marked Pascal compute architectures as deprecated.

predictions.statement: Within 90 days of version 1.2 release, Bun passes 100% of Node.js cluster module compatibility test suite.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Bun compatibility tracker reports 100% pass on node:cluster standard conformance tests.
predictions.postmortem: Wrong. Bun prioritized HTTP server multithreading over legacy process-forking cluster emulation.

predictions.statement: Within 90 days of model release, quantized 405B parameter model achieves inference on single 8xH100 node.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Reproducible GitHub repository demonstrates >15 tokens/sec per stream on 8xH100 using FP4/FP8.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. FP4 tensor sharding allowed 405B parameter models to serve on single 8-GPU nodes.

predictions.statement: Within 30 days of public beta, Cloudflare Vectorize demonstrates p99 query latency under 15ms globally.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Independent benchmark telemetry validates global p99 latency <15ms across 100k vector index.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. Edge-located vector indexes met sub-15ms p99 latency SLA.

predictions.statement: Within 365 days, a European sovereign cloud consortium announces deployment of >10,000 high-end AI accelerators.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Consortium press release and independent auditor verify commissioning of 10k+ clusters in EU datacenter.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. EuroHPC AI Factories initiative confirmed deployment of 16,000 GPU cluster.

predictions.statement: Within 365 days, SWE-bench Verified replaces MMLU as the primary benchmark cited in frontier lab technical reports.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Frontier model announcements cite SWE-bench resolution rates prominently on headline benchmark graphs.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. SWE-bench Verified became the industry de-facto metric for frontier agent capability.

predictions.statement: Within 30 days of release, PostgreSQL 17 includes native JSON_TABLE support conforming to SQL:2016.
predictions.resolution_criteria: PostgreSQL official release notes confirm JSON_TABLE function in core query planner.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. PostgreSQL 17 shipped JSON_TABLE in general availability.

predictions.statement: Within 365 days of pgvector 0.7 release, at least two dedicated vector databases add native Postgres wire protocol compatibility.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Official docs of at least 2 standalone vector DBs confirm psql client compatibility.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. Qdrant and Milvus added Postgres protocol adaptors to prevent migration friction.

predictions.statement: Within 365 days of initial reasoning model launch, production generation latency falls below 150ms per reasoning token.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Benchmarking APIs confirm time-per-output-token <150ms on extended chain-of-thought generations.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. Speculative decoding and optimized KV cache compression reduced reasoning latency to 110ms/tok.

predictions.statement: Within 365 days, leading commercial coding assistant launches multi-file autonomous workspace refactoring in GA.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Official release notes document multi-file diff generation and dependency-aware edits in production tiers.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. Multi-file edit capabilities reached general availability across major IDE assistants.

predictions.statement: Within 365 days, US antitrust regulator issues binding consent decree prohibiting exclusive cloud compute credits for AI startups.
predictions.resolution_criteria: FTC or DOJ public docket publishes formal signed consent decree barring compute-for-equity exclusivity.
predictions.postmortem: Wrong. The FTC published an extensive inquiry report detailing compute lock-in, but issued guidance rather than a binding consent decree.

predictions.statement: Within 90 days of launch, GitHub Copilot Chat exposes Claude 3.5 Sonnet to Enterprise users.
predictions.resolution_criteria: GitHub Copilot settings allow selecting Anthropic Claude models for enterprise seats.
predictions.postmortem: Correct. GitHub enabled multi-model choice including Claude 3.5 Sonnet for Enterprise seats.

predictions.statement: Within 30 days, at least two competing agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain, AutoGen) ship pull requests supporting the Open Agent Protocol standard.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Official pull request or release in langchain-ai or microsoft/autogen implementing conforming protocol client.

predictions.statement: By 30 June 2027, at least three leading open-source inference runtimes (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) natively support cross-session shared KV-cache eviction APIs matching commercial cloud standards.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Published release notes in official GitHub repositories documenting standardized shared KV-cache session eviction endpoint.

predictions.statement: By 30 June 2027, at least three of the top five open-weight foundational model architectures adopt MLA as their default attention architecture.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Published model architecture papers on arXiv from major labs (e.g. Meta, Mistral, Qwen) explicitly specify Multi-Head Latent Attention in model specifications.

predictions.statement: By 31 August 2027, at least two major browser vendors (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) merge native virtualized OS agent permission sandboxes.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Official browser release notes document isolated agent sandbox profile with restricted credential access and synthetic input isolation.

predictions.statement: By 30 September 2027, the PyTorch core repository merges bidirectional pipeline parallelism scheduling inspired by DualPipe.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Merged commit in pytorch/pytorch implementing bidirectional pipeline parallel overlap schedule with benchmark documentation.
